**The document doesn't contain this number.** Figure 7, which shows key-value retrieval accuracy by position, is included only as an image. Its plotted values aren't in the text, and there's no appendix table of key-value results. The tabulated results in Appendix G cover only the multi-document QA task (p. 18).

What the text does say about LongChat-13B (16K) with 140 key-value pairs:

- It "exhibits a different trend in the 140 key-value setting" from the other models (p. 6).
- When the relevant key is placed at the start of the context, it "tends to generate code to retrieve the key, rather than outputting the value directly" (p. 6).
- In general, models other than Claude-1.3 and Claude-1.3 (100K) "struggle, especially when contexts have 140 or 300 key-value pairs" (p. 6).
- Without query-aware contextualization, the worst-case performance across the key-value experiments is 45.6% (p. 7). The text doesn't say which model or position this is.

To get the exact accuracy at the 70th position, you'd need to read it off the Figure 7 plot or use the authors' released code and data (p. 2).
